challenge.method: Under pinned SCES-1.0 §§1, 3–4 and Protocol stage 7, compared the package's GPL text and example application notice with the appended OpenSSL clause. Tested a package-wide permission and a package-wide base-version election.
challenge.results: The copyright holders limit the grant to ‘portions of this program’ and refer to individual files. The GPL's example notice cannot resolve a backend's version election. These boundaries support the asserted publication of a scoped exception.

limitations: COPYING contains GPL version 2. Establishing the base-version election or coverage of a particular backend requires that file's declaration.
The permission preserves GPL requirements for code other than OpenSSL. A modifier may omit the exception. Other releases require separate evidence.
